name: 要約を時間から探す音声目次
prompt:
Create one portrait image for the assigned audio-summary outline component at the exact 390:575 aspect ratio. Reference 1 is the original Blinkist screen crop and controls the component structure, active tab, row hierarchy, timestamp alignment, and divider rhythm. Reference 2 is the Japanese mock cropped to the assigned region and controls the exact Japanese labels and compact layout. Keep the original hierarchy: a two-tab header with the second tab active; one larger 0:00 summary row; then six numbered outline rows. In each row, align a time chip in a narrow left column and the text in a wider right column. Use a bold muted section number followed by regular body text, with a thin neutral divider between rows. The summary text is more prominent than the six body rows. Keep all lines and rows legible without collisions.

Copy all Japanese labels exactly and include no additional rows or words. Tabs: 「本について」 (inactive) and 「要約の目次」 (active). The overview at 0:00 is 「この要約で分かること：」 followed by 「お金の判断と心のつながり」. The six timestamped rows are:
1:10 — 「誰もがお金と経済の経験を持っています」
3:56 — 「個人の経験が、お金の判断を変えます」
7:03 — 「いまの経済にも歴史の影響が残っています」
9:48 — 「運と偶然の役割は思った以上に大きいものです」
12:24 — 「一つの事例よりも大きな傾向に注目します」
15:04 — 「うらやむ気持ちは無理な判断につながります」

Use a flat pure-white #FFFFFF canvas and white row surfaces. Use near-black #1D1D1D for primary Japanese copy, muted gray for the inactive tab and bold row numbers, and a restrained forest-green #1F6444 underline for the active tab. Keep time labels as one coherent data group: white fill, a fine neutral outline, and forest-green text. Use thin light-neutral separators. No mint panels, green wash, texture, glow, decorative icons, or phone chrome. The mock is 390x610 but has 35px blank space below the assigned component; use only the supplied 390x575 mock crop and do not reproduce that extra blank margin. Output only this component crop, with no added controls or surrounding screen.
reviewNotes: Raw ImageGen candidate, 1033x1523, visually compared with the original source crop and Japanese mock. Preserves the active Outline tab, overview row, six numbered timestamp sections and exact Japanese copy; white surfaces, forest-green underline and quiet outlined time group follow current DESIGN.md. No generated pixels were post-processed. An unregistered v001 PNG already existed and was preserved, so this registration is v002. reviewed means visual inspection report only; no owner approval or native implementation.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
